RADIOS.LABEL: Radios
RADIOS.NONE: No WiFi or Bluetooth radios found

RECOVERY.LABEL: Network
RECOVERY.ETH: A wired network is connected. You can still reach this device over the cable.
RECOVERY.NO_ETH: No wired network. WiFi turns off now and comes back after reboot. Bluetooth stays off across reboot if you leave it off.
RECOVERY.NO_ETH_PERSIST: No wired network. WiFi will stay off across reboot until you enable WiFi or disable flight mode on this page. If you lose the UI: a network cable, or an empty file named wifi on a USB stick or in /boot.
RECOVERY.SENTINEL: WiFi recovery file found. WiFi will stay on until that file is removed from /boot or the USB volume.

PERSIST.TOKEN_DOC: Type the code exactly. It is shown on this page so you confirm you can read it.
PERSIST.NOTE_CHALLENGE: No network cable. After reboot this device will not be reachable over WiFi. Use this only if the unit has a screen or you have another way back in.
PERSIST.NOTE_RECOVER: This page before reboot (Enable WiFi or Disable flight mode), a network cable, or an empty file named wifi on a USB stick or in /boot. More detail is in this plugin's README.
PERSIST.NOTE_ACTIVE: WiFi will stay off across reboot until you enable WiFi or disable flight mode on this page.
PERSIST.NOTE_SENTINEL: A wifi recovery file is present. Persist cannot be enabled until that file is removed from /boot or the USB volume. More detail is in this plugin's README.

HARDBLOCK.NOTE: A hardware airplane switch has turned a radio off. That cannot be cleared in software.

CONFIRM.ENABLE_ETH: WiFi and Bluetooth will turn off and stay off across reboot. You can still reach this device over the cable.
CONFIRM.ENABLE_NO_ETH: WiFi and Bluetooth will turn off now. A reboot turns WiFi back on. Bluetooth stays off across reboot if you leave it off.
CONFIRM.ENABLE_NO_ETH_PERSIST: WiFi and Bluetooth will turn off and stay off across reboot until you disable flight mode or enable WiFi on this page.
CONFIRM.WIFI_ETH: WiFi will turn off and stay off across reboot. You can still reach this device over the cable.
CONFIRM.WIFI_NO_ETH: WiFi will turn off now. A reboot turns WiFi back on.
CONFIRM.WIFI_NO_ETH_PERSIST: WiFi will turn off and stay off across reboot until you enable WiFi or disable flight mode on this page.

TOAST.HARD_DENIED: A hardware switch is blocking a radio. This cannot override it.
TOAST.PERSIST_ON: WiFi will stay off across reboot
TOAST.PERSIST_BAD: The code did not match. Try again with the new code.
TOAST.PERSIST_SENTINEL: A wifi recovery file is present. Remove it before enabling persist.
